emails.text:
Dear Dr. Phyllis K. Hernandez:
I am so happy to receive your invitation to join as a reviewer, and I've just sent the application to the website. According to my research plan, I hope to publish my next research paper in the next few months, and I will keep in touch with you before and after it is published.

My research area is sustainable tourism and its application in cultural heritage, and now I am participating in another research on culinary tourism. It is my honor to collaborate with you in these two areas and I will share our latest research information or ideas with you.

Wishing you a Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year.

Best regards,
Shutao Lan

________________________________

Para: SHUTAO LAN <100438330@alumnos.uc3m.es>
Asunto: Re: Follow Up with reference to Analysis of Madridos Cultural Heritage for the Chinese Tourism Market A Case Study of the Royal Site of San Lorenzo De El Escorial

Dear Dr. Lan,

I understand that you are currently busy with your research work, and we would like to keep our invitation open for your future unpublished research article.

Moreover, our editorial board has extended an invitation for you to join us as a reviewer. You can apply at:
https://globaljournals.org/board/apply-for-reviewer/for-management

What is the approximate time your research will be available for publication or when you plan to start drafting your paper? It would also be helpful if you could share your research interests, as it will aid our familiarity and potentially connect you with other researchers.

Also, could you let us know your university's research focus areas and your involvement in them? We would like to collaborate with you and your colleagues on upcoming conferences or webinars at your university, and our society can provide support with webinar technologies.

With more than two decades of being an open-access journal, our print circulation and readership are among the highest, which will enhance the citations and h-index of your article. I recommend visiting https://globaljournals.org/journals/management or https://journalofbusiness.org for more information.

Wishing you a Merry Christmas filled with joy and cheer! Thank you for your continued support throughout the year. May your holidays sparkle with moments of love, laughter, and goodwill, and may the year ahead be full of contentment and joy. Happy Holidays from all of us

With best regards,
